name: warren-plugin-whistle
description: 为每个环境托管独立的 Whistle 实例：代理、规则、预设与抓包面板。

commands.name: list
commands.summary: 列出所有代理实例：端口、存活、绑定的环境、规则

commands.name: fork
commands.summary: 起一个新实例：--input='{"storage":"a","hostPattern":"app.example.com/static/","targetPort":5199}'

commands.name: start
commands.summary: 把 list 里 alive:false 的已登记实例按原端口原 storage 拉起：--input='{"storage":"a"}'

commands.name: stop
commands.summary: 停掉一个实例：--input='{"storage":"a"}'

commands.name: remove
commands.summary: 停掉并忘掉一个实例（Whistle 的规则文件留在磁盘上）：--input='{"storage":"a"}'

commands.name: bind
commands.summary: 把实例绑到环境（写 proxy + 信任它的根证书，环境在跑就重启）：--env=<环境> --input='{"storage":"a"}'

commands.name: unbind
commands.summary: 解除环境的代理绑定（清 proxy + trustedCa，环境在跑就重启）：--env=<环境>

commands.name: open
commands.summary: 只打开当前环境绑定实例的 Web UI，不启动服务；实例没跑时请先 start：--env=<环境>

commands.name: presetList
commands.summary: 列出用户已导入的预设与 online/test/local/preview 场景

commands.name: presetGet
commands.summary: 读取用户预设 revision：--input='{"id":"<preset-id>"}'

commands.name: presetPreview
commands.summary: 合成预设并返回 rules/hash/warnings；--input 可带 scenario

commands.name: presetApply
commands.summary: 按 scenario 组合应用预设；expectedHash 防覆盖，失败自动回滚

commands.name: presetSave
commands.summary: 保存自定义预设：--input='{"definition":{...}}'

commands.name: presetDelete
commands.summary: 删除自定义预设：--input='{"id":"..."}'

commands.name: presetImport
commands.summary: 把规则文本导入为 draft：--input='{"text":"..."}'

commands.name: presetExport
commands.summary: 导出预设 JSON：--input='{"id":"..."}'

commands.name: profileGet
commands.summary: 读取实例当前预设 profile：--input='{"storage":"..."}'

commands.name: profileClear
commands.summary: 清除实例 profile，不改 Whistle 规则

commands.name: ruleGet
commands.summary: 读取单个规则组：--input='{"storage":"...","name":"warren"}'

commands.name: rules
commands.summary: 读取实例的规则组、selected 与多选开关：--input='{"storage":"..."}'

commands.name: ruleSet
commands.summary: 写入并选中一组规则（写后回读 hash/selected，失败回滚）：--input='{"storage":"...","name":"warren","rules":"..."}'

commands.name: ruleToggle
commands.summary: 启用/停用一组规则，正文 hash 不变：--input='{"storage":"...","name":"warren","enabled":true}'

commands.name: ruleRemove
commands.summary: 删除一组规则：--input='{"storage":"...","name":"warren"}'

commands.name: ruleValidate
commands.summary: 校验规则文本：--input='{"rules":"..."}'

commands.name: ruleDiff
commands.summary: 对比实例当前规则与目标文本

commands.name: traffic
commands.summary: 读取实例实时请求/响应：--input='{"storage":"a","urls":["/cgi/capi"],"methods":["POST"]}'

commands.name: compose
commands.summary: 经实例主动发请求并返回响应：--input='{"storage":"a","url":"https://...","method":"POST","data":"..."}'

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: 检查实例存活、HTTPS 解密、HTTP2、多选规则与根证书

commands.name: agent
commands.summary: 调用 Whistle 2.10.7+ 官方 Local Agent API：--input='{"storage":"a","method":"rules.getList","args":[]}'

commands.name: agentStatus
commands.summary: 读取官方 Agent API 状态：network/rules/plugins/HTTPS

commands.name: frames
commands.summary: 读取 WebSocket/流式帧：--input='{"storage":"a","reqId":"...","lastFrameId":"..."}'

commands.name: export
commands.summary: 导出规则/session：--input='{"storage":"a","type":"har","directory":"/abs"}'

settings.label: 外部 w2 路径
settings.description: 留空 = 使用插件内置的 Whistle；填了就用你指定的 fork

settings.label: 端口起始值
settings.description: 新实例从这往后找第一个能用的端口；8899 被本地 fixture 占用，已跳过

settings.label: WHISTLE_PATH
settings.description: 留空 = 用 WARREN_HOME/whistle，所有实例共用一张根证书
